title: CANDO: A Compiled Programming Language for Computer-Aided Nanomaterial Design and Optimization
summary: Christian Schafmeister presents CANDO at the 2016 European Lisp Symposium. It is a compiled Lisp-based language for designing macromolecules and nanoscale materials, built on the Clasp implementation of Common Lisp.
why: Recommended as one of the best talks of the symposium for the unusual scope of applying Lisp to molecular design.

quote.text: no wonder CANDO is impressive, the scope and fields involved are pretty rare
